    Character decomposition of Hochschild cochains #

    weights-and-parameters.tex: "Integer ray weights also grade A₀ and its Hochschild complex, and we write HH²(A₀)_χ for the component of weight χ ∈ L. Since deg_J ∈ H_ℤ, this decomposition refines the decomposition by internal degree."

    For an algebra Λ with a length grading G, vertex idempotents of weight zero and a compatible lattice grading W: the character-χ part cpr2 χ φ of a two-cochain is a cochain of character χ; it is a cocycle, relative, of the same internal degree when φ is, and φ is the finite sum of its character parts (sum_cpr2). The coboundary commutes with the character parts (cobdry_cpr1).

    Also (exists_rel_cobdry): "Inserting the primitive idempotents contracts the complementary summands of the bar complex, so these relative cochains compute ordinary Hochschild cohomology" (weights-and-parameters.tex), in the form used: a normalized relative cocycle which is the coboundary of some one-cochain of degree q is the coboundary of a normalized relative one-cochain of degree q. The correction is the inner derivation of u = ∑ f(e_j) e_j.
